claims.explanation: BI-78D3 was originally described as a JNK/JIP1 substrate-competitive inhibitor, but the more recent mechanistic evidence shows it covalently binds the D-recruitment site of ERK2 (C159) and kills ERK-pathway-dependent melanoma cells, including BRAF V600E and BRAF-inhibitor-resistant lines. Selectivity therefore tracks dependence on MAPK/ERK signaling rather than JNK: lines with BRAF/NRAS mutations, RTK-driven ERK activation, or loss of negative regulators such as NF1/PTEN are sensitized, while lines with alternative survival wiring (e.g., EGFR-mutant lung lines that are not ERK-addicted, or mesenchymal/colorectal lines with redundant pathways) are protected.

features.basis: BRAF V600E melanoma lines (LOXIMVI, UACC62, IGR37) are among the most killed; BI-78D3 kills BRAF-inhibitor-naive and resistant BRAF V600E melanoma cells (PMID 31745079)
NRAS-mutant melanoma/urinary lines (KU1919, IPC298 context) show ERK-pathway dependence; ERK DRS targeting disrupts ERK signaling (PMID 31745079)
NF1 loss hyperactivates RAS-ERK; NF1-mutant lines (FTC133, BICR6, LOXIMVI) are enriched among sensitive lines
PTEN loss co-occurs with ERK/PI3K dependence in sensitive lines (FTC133, ZR751, UACC62)
BI-78D3 was designed as a JNK1 (MAPK8) inhibitor; high JNK1 expression may buffer ERK-DRS inhibition or reflect non-ERK-addicted lines
JIP1 scaffolding enhances JNK signaling and JIP1 inhibition sensitizes osteosarcoma to chemotherapy; high JIP1 may mark JNK-dependent rather than ERK-dependent lines (PMID 23045411)
EGFR-mutant NSCLC lines (HCC4006, NCIH1650, NCIH1648 context) are largely in the least-affected set, suggesting EGFR-driven lines are not ERK-DRS-addicted
KRAS-mutant colorectal/pancreatic lines (CL11, OV7, SNUC5) appear among least affected, consistent with KRAS-driven tumors using redundant survival pathways
TP53 mutation is near-universal in sensitive lines but also common in resistant lines, so it is a weak, non-specific correlate
MAP2K1-mutant NCIH1437 is among least affected, suggesting MEK-mutant lines may not require ERK DRS interactions
ARID1A loss appears in several sensitive lines (LOXIMVI, KU1919) but also resistant lines, weak evidence
KMT2D mutation enriched in sensitive squamous/gastric lines (KYSE270, BICR6, KE39) but also in resistant SNUC5, weak evidence
